lineage.note: Humboldt CSI's official Bubblegum S1 page identifies the line as Bubblegum (Indiana cut) × Bubblegum (Indiana cut). Together with the official S1 designation, this is treated as a selfed S1 line; no additional ancestry is inferred.

aromas.note: Customer-review or parent-cut aroma observations are not generalized to the complete Bubblegum S1 line.

terpenes.note: The official Bubblegum S1 page does not provide a cultivar-specific lot terpene profile or COA for the S1 line.

origin.note: The official Bubblegum S1 page identifies the Indiana cut used for the self-cross but does not state the S1 line's exact creation location; no location is inferred.

history.note: The official Bubblegum S1 page does not provide a sufficiently bounded cultivar-specific release chronology; no secondary history is imported.
